title: After handover, must Emily and her own Claude sign their commits to her site?
why: CLAUDE.md and the site's policy say every commit is signed with the keeper's own published key. Emily, as owner, may not have a key. The handover notes need to say which applies before she starts.
checks: no change made yet; CLAUDE.md and site/policy stay as they are unless Dinis says otherwise
options: a) Emily and her Claude need not sign; emily.b says so in docs/handover.md and docs/prompt-for-your-claude.md, and CLAUDE.md gets a line for the owner (a CLAUDE.md change, which needs this yes)
b) They must sign; emily.b adds key set-up steps to docs/prompt-for-your-claude.md
c) Leave as is for now
